items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: So Gary called me up and says, “Swallow keeps mentioning that we’re looking for a new drummer. Roy Haynes is leaving the group, would you like to audition for the gig?”

ctx.x: I’m here because — speaking of bass players — because of Steve Swallow. He just kept mentioning my name to Gary because Steve and I were friends and he said, “You know Bill Goodwin would really like to do this gig, he’s often said that to me.” So Gary called me up and says, “Swallow keeps mentioning that we’re looking for a new drummer. Roy Haynes is leaving the group, would you like to audition for the gig?” I said, “Yeah I would, man, it’d be great.” So he sends me a ticket and I fly back to New York and we go…
